fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-03-25, the complainant was stopped by a group near Mynthan Colony Main Street, and a gold ring along with cash of around Rs. 2,200 were taken under threat. The time of the incident was given as 21:25 on 2026-03-23. The complaint was lodged by Divya Sekar (9000000371). Prakash Muthu (9000000312) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A blue scooter with registration TN-33-YY-1007 was observed near Mynthan Colony Main Street. Karthik Rajan (mobile 9000000091) was named as a possible person of interest. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00341, as the mobile number 9000000091 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken. A scooter was reportedly used to leave the area.
